title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Accounting Paper 1
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Accounting Paper 1 (multiple choice): 40 questions, 40 marks, 1 hour 30 minutes, covering the whole syllabus. Questions are drawn from the bank, so every attempt is a new paper. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** 40 questions. You have 1 hour 30 minutes.

- Each question is worth 1 mark. Choose the one best answer; there are four options.
- You may use a calculator. Work out each figure before you choose.
- The paper is marked when you submit or when the time runs out.

The format follows Paper 1 as described in the syllabus (0452, 2027-2029). Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of Cambridge IGCSE Accounting Paper 2
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on Cambridge IGCSE Accounting Paper 2: five compulsory 20-mark structured questions based on stimulus material, 1 hour 45 minutes, 100 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** five questions. You have 1 hour 45 minutes.

- Each question is worth 20 marks. Show your workings: they are part of the mark scheme.
- Numerical answers are marked automatically; ledger accounts, statements and written explanations are shown with our model layout and mark scheme after you submit, so that you can mark them yourself.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 as described in the syllabus (0452, 2027-2029). Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
